WOODWORK — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Furniture Making, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Furniture Making.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Furniture Making.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Furniture Making.

2. When learning Entrepreneurship in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Blending wood with other materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Blending wood with other materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending wood with other materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending wood with other materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending wood with other materials.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

6. When learning Upholstery, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Upholstery.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Upholstery.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Upholstery.

7. When learning Emergency Management, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emergency Management.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emergency Management.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Emergency Management.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.

8. When learning Design in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Design in Woodwork.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Design in Woodwork.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Design in Woodwork.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.

9. When learning Occupational Information, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Occupational Information.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Occupational Information.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.

10. When learning Framed Wooden Doors and Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

12. When learning Estimation of Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Estimation of Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Estimation of Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Estimation of Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Estimation of Materials.

13. When learning Project Activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project Activity.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Activity.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Activity.

14. When learning Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fittings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fittings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fittings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fittings.

15. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Furniture Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Framed Wooden Doors and Windows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Fittings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Upholstery and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Project Activity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Design in Woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
